Did some mild refactoring, rewrote the program to use StateT, for better or worse, since input stage was consolidated. A bit disappointing because StateT is pretty imperative, and is strictly unnecessary, but I didn't want to lazily call getOutputPath at the end as to keep inputs monolithic. The bug with writing to files is still extant, and I'm sure there's a lot more. It's quite disappointing in its own way; I keep on writing horrible shitcode. Improvements have been made from the original interation, which is substantially smaller, and with minimum sanitization, but not to my full satisfaction.
